label: counterexample
problem_title: Complete monotonicity of squared derivative ratios of Mill's ratio

evidence.text:
For the actual Gaussian Mills ratio r, the quotient -r^2/r' has negative fortieth derivative throughout some interval of strictly positive regular inputs. This refutes Ferreira–Simon Conjecture 3 already at n=0. A degree-21 integer polynomial in pi/2, rational Bernstein bounds and continuity supply the certificate.
